RunnerContractReview.explanation:
No introduced correctness or security blocker survived the scoped review and hostile second pass against f65f0548: operators can select side-by-side sing-box binaries/configs, with the same resolved executable used for launch, PID measurement and shutdown (bench/lab-bench.sh:40–41,122–140,215–223); regular TCP/UDP stdout is captured before parsing (279–300,424–439); all six added echo-port rules reach declared outbounds rather than direct fallback (bench/sb-client.json:125–172), the measured proxy-* groups match their filters and routing references, attribution-ready.json records all 18 TCP and 18 UDP proxy routes with server-observed source 10.10.10.70 versus direct-control source 10.10.10.49, and the cleanup snapshots preserve ens3/tailscale, lab and both allocator-state byte dumps while removing the native-test namespaces/links.
Final tables must identify the main UTC window 2026-10-10 19:54:28–20:34:38 and official dae v2.1.1/sing-box v1.14.3 identities from campaign metadata; describe honk as the shipped opt-s release-profile musl build with ebpf,native-api and default clash-api,mimalloc,rprx but no configured native listener; label cold as post-restart first HTTP-request latency after readiness waits, not daemon startup duration or guaranteed cold TLS/QUIC establishment; use integer MiB for post-TCP RSS, identify CPU as measured engine-process cores rather than total-system cost, and describe the comparison as complete eBPF/TPROXY versus mixed-TUN stacks with achieved loaded pressure shown per arm, not identical interception or equal load; additionally distinguish the direct control's single first request from the three-restart proxy median, note that standard UDP has one bandwidth sample and no direct UDP row, mark main sing-box HY2 UDP bandwidth/loss invalid rather than zero and avoid throughput-efficiency claims from that failed sample, keep any later rerun separately dated without replacing the main result, and treat VLESS/VMess/Juicity exclusions as coverage limits rather than current capability findings.
Clock evidence records a one-time correction from approximately -34.88 seconds to -0.056 seconds against an NTP-synchronized reference, unchanged NTP policy and the failed RTC attempt, with server-side SS2022 timestamp rejection retained and no validation-relaxation setting added; pre-existing runner limitations include swallowed standard iperf parse failures, unchecked sing-box readiness, broad honk/dae executable matching, fixed external namespace-rebuild assumptions and small/sequential samples, so these are reporting caveats rather than patch-introduced blockers, and this read-only review ran no checks or remote commands and inspected neither the plan, merged-source changes, historical results nor partial followup data.

EvidenceAudit.explanation:
Read-only audit completed against B = bench/results/abc-2026-10-11-x86; no benchmarks/checks were rerun and no follow-up measurements were read.

Verified inventory and arithmetic:
- results.tsv: 39 unique standard rows = 21 TCP/direct + 18 UDP; stability.tsv: 21 unique loaded rows; command-0001.stdout reproduces both tables
- raw/*-*.tcp-{1,2,3}.json: all 63 standard TCP samples have completed approximately eight-second receiver totals and no iperf error; all 21 medians match median(floor(receiver_bps / 1,000,000))
- TCP median Mbps, ordered honk / dae / sing-box: direct 9406 / 9405 / 9400; HY2 3135 / 3762 / 2860; TUIC 3561 / 3306 / 3265; SS2022 9396 / 9399 / 9389; Trojan 9380 / 9390 / 9383; AnyTLS-SB 9394 / 9381 / 9388; AnyTLS-Go 9387 / 9380 / 9376
- raw/*-520{1..6}.udp.json: 18 captured samples, 17 completed and one invalid; all 17 completed receiver rates and one-decimal loss values match results.tsv, with receiver rates independently matching received bytes × 8 / receiver seconds and loss matching lost_packets / packets
- raw/*.samples.jsonl and raw/*.summary.json: all 21 arms contain exactly 200 ordered indices with consistent identities and 250 ms scheduled offsets; 4,200 attempts = 4,194 successes + six retained failures; success-only nearest-rank p50/p95/p99, maximum, mean, population standard deviation, spread and scheduling-lag summaries match, allowing floating-point roundoff
- Retained failures are TimeoutError with null HTTP status and approximately 5,005 ms elapsed: honk-hy2 indices 135, 188, 197 (3/200); dae-tuic indices 110, 113 (2/200); dae-anytls-sb index 197 (1/200); all other arms have zero failures
- raw/*.iperf.json: all 21 loaded pressure runs have completed approximately 57-second reverse single-stream TCP totals, 57 positive-rate intervals, no iperf error and empty paired *.iperf.err; rounded receiver rates match every stability.tsv load value
- Loaded Mbps, ordered honk / dae / sing-box: direct 9408 / 9404 / 9407; HY2 3048 / 3509 / 2672; TUIC 3645 / 3436 / 3288; SS2022 9402 / 9402 / 9396; Trojan 9389 / 9380 / 9364; AnyTLS-SB 9388 / 9378 / 9363; AnyTLS-Go 9354 / 9386 / 9370
- Worst arm scheduling-lag p99 is 0.438104 ms, worst individual lag 2.036112 ms; all requests, including timeouts, finish by approximately 54.255 s relative to their collector anchor
- commands.jsonl records exit status 0 and UTC 2026-10-10 19:54:28–20:34:38; command-0001.stderr binary hashes match metadata.json; attribution-ready.json independently confirms 18 TCP proxy routes, 18 UDP proxy routes and three direct controls with no attribution mismatch

Exact discrepancy requiring publication treatment: results.tsv row 29 and command-0001.stdout retain sing-box HY2 UDP as 0(-), but raw/sing-box-5201.udp.json contains error "server test duration expired: ", seven positive intervals and an empty end object, so the report must label that measurement INVALID rather than zero or any reconstructed positive terminal rate, while preserving the original artifacts.

Material comparative facts and limits:
- HY2 TCP favors dae and TUIC TCP favors honk in this campaign; direct and stream-based protocols cluster near the approximately 9.4 Gbps ceiling rather than establishing meaningful speed rankings
- Loaded Trojan p99 is 8.842 / 22.010 / 17.291 ms at similar achieved loads and zero failures; honk is not the universal tail winner—SS2022 p99 is 13.012 / 10.356 / 11.641 ms and AnyTLS-Go p99 is 17.358 / 8.523 / 15.281 ms
- HY2 success-only p99 is 2.623 / 3.413 / 25.597 ms, but honk also has 1.5% timeouts and achieved loads differ substantially; success-only maximum 2.868 ms is not the worst latency across all honk HY2 attempts
- Successful direct-path outliers remain present: honk index 113 at 1007.208 ms and sing-box index 167 at 1034.084 ms; their small scheduling lag does not establish an engine-specific cause
- Reported TCP daemon CPU is lower for honk than sing-box on all six proxy routes, but only four of six versus dae; dae uses less process CPU on both AnyTLS routes; proxy RSS is 42–47 MiB for honk, 59–63 MiB for dae and 66–76 MiB for sing-box
- CPU uses /proc/<pid>/stat utime+stime from the median-throughput run, not whole-host/kernel/eBPF/softirq CPU; individual CPU tick/wall-time and cold/hot request samples are not retained, so those metrics can be checked against stdout but not independently reconstructed from raw bandwidth JSON
- Completed UDP loss spans 55.4–87.4% at a configured saturating 10 Gbps target; these are lossy stress measurements, not demonstrated low-loss capacity
- Only one sequential campaign, three short TCP runs per route, one UDP sample per route and one loaded window per route; no equal-load tail comparison, confidence interval, general repeatability, internet/ARM extrapolation, intrinsic language/datapath attribution or historical regression claim; native-api is compiled in but its listener is unconfigured
